name: stats-minimal
title: Minimal Stats Row
blurb: Horizontal row of stats with value, label, and subtle hover background.
description: Section component displaying stats in a horizontal flex layout. Each stat shows a bold value (e.g., 1.2M+) and a small uppercase label. Stats are separated by left borders. Hover fills background with light gray. Hardcoded stat data.
use_when: Minimal hero sections or inline stat displays where simplicity is the priority.
avoid_when: Reusable stat component; data is hardcoded.
a11y: Simple text hierarchy with p elements. Good contrast on default state. Hover adds subtle background.
